first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses both the 4% completion decline and the 6% activation decline, with two inherited findings indicating durable activation and early-adoption gains. This is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than reacting immediately with discounts, which may lift acquisition but has less evidence here on downstream customer quality and durability. Verify memory_31 to assess experiment design, segment comparability, and whether activation gains translated into retained or qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a targeted SMB signup-simplification experiment. The verified source directly addresses the current onboarding and activation declines and showed signup +15%, activation +9%, and qualified revenue +4%. The 30-day retention decline of 1% warrants explicit retention and qualified-revenue guardrails, and the result should not be generalized beyond SMB because it was not replicated in other segments.
